reserved_name: {}: a name Runique keeps for itself
not_a_file: {}: not the path of a file
duplicate: {}: this file is already in the batch
journal_forged: {}: names a path the batch could not have written
stray_backup: {}: has a backup, though nothing was there before the batch
gone: {}: is gone, and no backup holds it
not_created: {}: is not the file the batch was creating
changed: {}: changed since the batch was interrupted, and its backup holds something else
stranger: {}: not a file of the batch, in a folder the batch created
moved_out: {}: is no longer in the journal's folder
unfinished: the batch did not finish after its passes
wrong_step: this action cannot be done at this step of the file
